description_en: Queries the data backups and restorable points of an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 查看AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例的数据备份列表和可恢复点
name: DescribeDataBackups

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the details of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specific region, including the instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup set. If this parameter is specified, the details of the backup set are queried.

You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/210093.html operation to query the information about all backup sets of the target instance, including the backup set IDs
parameters.help_zh:
备份集ID。如果带上BackupId，则是查询该备份详情。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/210093.html查看目标实例下的所有备份集信息，包括备份集ID
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。格式： yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，需要大于查询开始时间。格式： yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

30
50
100

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数。取值说明：

30
50
100

默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be a positive integer. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The backup type. Valid values:

DATA: full backup.
RESTOREPOI: restorable point.

If you do not specify this parameter, full backup sets are returned by default
parameters.help_zh:
备份类型。取值说明：

DATA：全量备份。
RESTOREPOI：可恢复点。

如果不传，则默认返回全量备份集的记录
parameters.name: data_type

parameters.help_en:
The backup mode. Valid values:

Automated: automatic backup.
Manual: manual backup.

If you do not specify this parameter, all backup modes are returned
parameters.help_zh:
备份模式。取值说明：

Automated：系统自动备份。
Manual：手动备份。

如果不传，则返回所有
parameters.name: backup_mode

parameters.help_en:
The status of the backup set. Valid values:

Success: The backup is completed.
Failed: The backup failed.

If you do not specify this parameter, backup sets in all states are returned
parameters.help_zh:
备份集状态。取值说明：

Success：已完成备份。
Failed：备份失败。

如果不传，则返回所有
parameters.name: backup_status

BackupEndTime.description_en: The end time of the backup. The time is displayed in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format and in UTC
BackupEndTime.description_zh: 备份结束时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

BackupEndTimeLocal.description_en: The end time of the backup in local time
BackupEndTimeLocal.description_zh: 本次备份结束时间（当地时间）

BackupMethod.description_en:
The backup method. Valid values:

Physical: physical backup.
Snapshot: snapshot backup
BackupMethod.description_zh:
备份方式，返回值如下：
Physical：物理备份
Snapshot：快照备份

BackupMode.description_en:
The backup mode.

Valid values for full backups:

Automated: automatic backup performed by the system.
Manual: manual backup.

Valid values for restorable points:

Automated: restorable point generated after a full backup.
Manual: restorable point manually triggered by the user.
Period: restorable point periodically triggered by the backup policy
BackupMode.description_zh:
备份模式。

全量备份取值说明：

Automated：系统自动备份。
Manual：手动备份。

恢复点取值说明：

Automated：全量备份后的恢复点。
Manual：用户手动触发的恢复点。
Period：因为备份策略，定时触发的恢复点

BackupSetId.description_en: The ID of the backup set

BackupSize.description_en: The size of the backup file. Unit: bytes

BackupStartTime.description_en: The start time of the backup. The time is displayed in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format and in UTC
BackupStartTime.description_zh: 备份开始时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

BackupStartTimeLocal.description_en: The start time of the backup in local time
BackupStartTimeLocal.description_zh: 本次备份开始时间（当地时间）

BackupStatus.description_en:
The status of the backup set. Valid values:

Success: successful.
Failure: failed
BackupStatus.description_zh:
备份集状态。取值说明：

Success：成功。
Failure：失败

BaksetName.description_en: The name of the restorable point or the full backup set
BaksetName.description_zh: 恢复点名称或全量备份集名称

ConsistentTime.description_en:
Full backup: the timestamp of the consistency point in time.
Restorable point: the timestamp of the restorable point in time
ConsistentTime.description_zh:
全量备份：返回一致性时间点的时间戳。
可恢复点：返回可恢复时间点的时间戳

DataType.description_en:
The backup type. Valid values:

DATA: full backup.
RESTOREPOI: restorable point
DataType.description_zh:
备份类型。取值说明：

DATA：全量备份。
RESTOREPOI：可恢复点

PageSize.description_en: The number of backup sets on the current page

TotalBackupSize.description_en: The total size of the backup sets. Unit: bytes
